svg.title: From character-by-character scanning to literal spans
svg.desc: Both paths read the same illustrative ASCII COPY row: alpha, a tab delimiter, beta, and a newline terminator. The original scanner builds a temporary field one character at a time. The optimized scanner finds boundaries and borrows unescaped fields. TAB and LF indicate single delimiter bytes, not backslash escape sequences.

g.aria-label: Ordinary characters are copied into a temporary field string.
Escapes need a temporary string; final text cells still own their strings.
